subject: This week's strangest signals: Ozempic/Wegovy usage footprint, On curiosity
preheader: Ozempic/Wegovy usage footprint for Novo Nordisk: −59% (11,819 → 4,820) vs the same period last year. Plus 4 more offbeat moves, explained in plain English.

picks.basis: vs the same period last year

paragraphs: Reports of side effects filed with the FDA that mention semaglutide, Novo's blockbuster drug. Report counts tend to grow with the number of people taking a drug.
Why it might matter for Novo Nordisk: more patients means more reports, so the trend is a rough proxy for how fast use is growing in the U.S. Caveat: a spike can also flag a real safety issue.
What it shows now: report volume is below a year ago.
